name: BESIII
summary: BESIII is located at BEPCII, Institute of High Energy Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing. It is a multipurpose tau–charm experiment; this record summarizes only its explicitly documented dark-sector directions.
detection_principle: Large charmonium, charm-meson, hyperon and light-meson samples enable rare-decay searches for invisible systems, single photons and new narrow resonances; methods including double tagging constrain missing final states.

results.summary: The collaboration summarizes dark-sector searches in D⁰, K⁰S, Ξ⁻, Σ⁺ and J/ψ; specific upper limits depend on the decay channel.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
